question: In how many years did total game releases exceed 3,000? (A) 6 (B) 3 (C) 2. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the steam stacked_bar chart. The y-axis runs to 5x the largest stack. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate axis range. True answer: B (3). Bait: A (6).
